talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $146.5M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, up 3479% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Bfkw, LLC (Grand Rapids, Other Health Care) targeting $12M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Penske Automotive Group, Inc. (PAG) disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan consumer & retail assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $141.3M raised so far — led by Bloomfield Capital Income Fund V, LLC - Series D (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
